description: Frozen naive generic prompts used only as a preregistered comparison baseline. They intentionally know the task ID but do not compile governed task closure.
scoring: For each accepted fixture, corrective-prompt proxy is the count of frozen expected_obligation_tokens absent as exact substrings from the rendered prompt. Compiled prompts are scored identically. Reduction=(baseline_missing-compiled_missing)/baseline_missing. Zero baseline denominator is unavailable, never zero.

templates.bootstrap: Prepare to work on {task_id} for candidate {candidate_version}. Use available project context.
templates.continuation: Continue {task_id} from the previous session and finish the remaining work.
templates.debug: Debug {task_id}. Fix the observed problem and rerun tests.
templates.implementation: Implement {task_id}. Follow project requirements and run the relevant tests.
templates.verification: Verify that {task_id} is complete and correct.
